passages.quote: A hearth interpreted as a combustion feature for quicklime production (Bar-Yosef 1983 ; Kingery et al. 1988 ) was found at Hayonim Cave, dating to the Early Natufian (c. 14 k cal BP)
Our study analysed lime plaster covering burials at a Natufian cemetery in Nahal Ein Gev II, dating to 12,000 years ago.
the widespread production of lime plaster are considered a development of farming societies during the Pre-Pottery Neolithic B (PPNB), which took place in the Levant beginning about 10,000 years ago
